defaultWorkerClass.description: Platform-selected class assigned to new standalone worker pools. Changing it does not classify legacy pools or move an existing pool.

valuesNamespaces.description: Existing non-tenant namespaces whose Secret and ConfigMap values the controller may GET. A managed tenant namespace grants it only the `cozystack-values` Secret, which an Application's HelmRelease reads its values from; a pool whose HelmRelease takes values from other Secrets or ConfigMaps needs a Role granting GET on them to the `kubernetes-worker-classes` ServiceAccount in `cozy-system`, or the controller reports that it cannot resolve the pool's values. Empty grants no additional namespaces.

replicas.description: Admission replicas. Controllers use leader election. Admission fails closed, so with one replica a node drain evicts the only webhook pod and every pool write fails until it runs again.

resources.description: Controller and webhook resource requests and limits.
